title: Update 20.3 for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central 2022 Release Wave 1
summary: Update 20.3 for Business Central 2022 release wave 1 includes hotfixes, feature changes like improved update settings and AppSourceCop validation, localization updates for VAT clauses and data export, and announcements about the Shopify Connector availability and Excel Add-in security updates.
